name: Rad Power Commercial Fleet eBike (RadRunner platform)
notes: Rad Power's commercial/fleet ebike built on the RadRunner utility platform (2019): 750 W geared hub motor, 672 Wh (48V 14Ah) battery, 145 kg total payload, modular cargo accessories; widely used in delivery fleets (e.g. Domino's DXB variant).

failure_modes.name: BMS/cell fault
failure_modes.symptom: Pack imbalance or BMS lockout; scooter reports low SoC or shuts down under load
failure_modes.mitigation: Periodic pack diagnostics, cell-balance check, replace packs failing capacity threshold

failure_modes.name: Brake wear
failure_modes.symptom: Increased stopping distance, grinding or loose lever feel
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled brake inspection/adjustment per service interval; replace pads/shoes/cables

failure_modes.name: IoT/GPS dropout
failure_modes.symptom: Vehicle goes offline, stale GPS fix, cannot be located/unlocked via app
failure_modes.mitigation: Firmware watchdog reboot, antenna inspection, swap IoT module if repeated dropouts

failure_modes.name: Connector corrosion
failure_modes.symptom: Intermittent power loss, throttle/display faults after rain or washdown
failure_modes.mitigation: Dielectric grease on connectors, inspect seals, replace corroded harness plugs

failure_modes.name: Vandalism
failure_modes.symptom: Broken display, cut brake lines, spray paint, forced lock or thrown in water
failure_modes.mitigation: Geofence alerts, tamper sensors, rapid retrieval workflow, hardened fasteners

failure_modes.name: Tire wear
failure_modes.symptom: Reduced traction, flats or flat spots, vibration at speed
failure_modes.mitigation: Tread/pressure checks each service cycle; replace tires past wear limit
